question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Naina has six children, and I always ________ with their names.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase '**get mixed up'** means to become confused or to mistake one thing for another. (गड़बड़ होना)

 
 
• **Example: **I always ***get mixed up*** between the twins because they look so similar.
 
 
 
• **'get rid of'** refers to removing or disposing of something unwanted. (से छुटकारा पाना)
 
 
• **Example: **She decided to ***get rid of al***l the old clothes she no longer wears.
 
 

Therefore, the correct statement is '**Naina has six children, and I always get mixed up__ with their names'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **get rid of** (से छुटकारा पाना): To remove or dispose of something.

 
 
• **Example:** She decided to **get rid of** all the old furniture in the house.
 
 
 
• **get away clean** (बिना पकड़े भाग जाना): To escape without getting caught or facing consequences.
 
 
• **Example:** The thief managed to **get away clean** after the robbery.
 
 
 
• **get cold feet** (डर जाना): To become nervous or anxious about something planned.
 
 
• **Example:** He **got cold feet** just before his wedding and almost called it off.
